expect: (() => { const P = window.G.player.pos, I = window.G.INTERIORS, b = I.ST.get('bockenheimer warte').p, k = I.ST.get('konstablerwache').p; return Math.hypot(P.x - b[0], P.z - b[1]) < 250 && Math.hypot(P.x - k[0], P.z - k[1]) > 500; })()
